name: scaling-hpo-sigmoid-20261015
purpose: Random search over the saturating size-aware parity-encoder schedule (S1) and the linear ablation (S0) for the parity-input lattice scaling models, selected on dev-grid MMD.

schedules.S1: t(beta) = tmax * [s(k_n (beta - b0)) - s(-k_n b0)] / [1 - s(-k_n b0)], s logistic, k_n = k * (n / 64)^gamma

training_budget: n_ops and mc_samples are reference-size values; at size n each is multiplied by (n / 64)^alpha and rounded to a multiple of 64

evaluation.note: trial-independent; each budget multiplied by (n / 64)^0.5; n_ops, n_samples and pair_samples rounded to a multiple of 64, target draws to an integer

objective: for each size, the minimum over checkpoints of R_Gamma(dev-grid MMD squared, banks averaged), R_Gamma(e) = (2 max e + trapezoidal mean e) / 3; trial score is the mean over sizes of log(max(score, 1e-8)); lower is better

confirmation.selection: per size, the best-checkpoint dev objective averaged over seeds; candidate score is the worst size; lowest eligible score wins
confirmation.shortlist: top three S1 search trials ranked by their worst size; the best S0 trial by the same rule is retrained as the linear-schedule ablation and is not eligible
confirmation.amendment: The search score (mean log over sizes) let one size compensate for the other. After the search, and before any confirmation run, the shortlist and the confirmation selection were changed to the worst size, because every size is reported. The search ranking under the original score is retained in the search results.
confirmation.data: each seed redraws the training and validation pools and the optimizer streams; dev pools, pair masks and evaluation keys are shared

final.selection: per size and seed, the restart and checkpoint with the lowest dev objective
final.candidate: the eligible confirmation winner, read from the confirmation results
final.note: one restart per fit so sizes up to 2048 finish in one overnight run

final_evaluation.budget_growth: mmd_ops, mmd_references and mmd_targets multiplied by (n/64)^growth_exponent as in the search evaluation
final_evaluation.note: held-out targets and keys are disjoint from training, dev selection and confirmation; banks are paired across checkpoints
